message: composer.json declares the git repository git@gitlab.example.com:acme/unused.git (repositories[4]), a VCS repository, which depcurfew.json denies (sources.git); composer.lock shows no package from it that depcurfew can tell, so Composer may install from it on the next update
fix: Remove the repository from composer.json and require the packages from Packagist, or set sources.git to "allow" in depcurfew.json

message: composer.lock installs acme/archive from an artifact repository (zip artifacts/acme-archive-1.0.0.zip), which depcurfew.json denies
fix: Use a registry version of acme/archive, or set sources.file to "allow" in depcurfew.json

message: composer.lock installs acme/local from a path repository (path packages/local), which depcurfew.json denies
fix: Use a registry version of acme/local, or set sources.directory to "allow" in depcurfew.json

message: composer.lock installs legacy/widgets from a package repository at a URL (zip https://downloads.example.com/widgets-1.0.0.zip), which depcurfew.json denies
fix: Use a registry version of legacy/widgets, or set sources.remoteTarball to "allow" in depcurfew.json

message: composer.lock installs monolog/monolog from a VCS repository (git https://github.com/acme/monolog-fork.git), which depcurfew.json denies
fix: Use a registry version of monolog/monolog, or set sources.git to "allow" in depcurfew.json
